title: ExtractedEntity
description: The grounding grain of the ingestion pipeline: an entity mention lifted from one IngestedDocument, with a canonical `normalized` form and the exact spans where it occurs. Generalizes Noetica doc-store linkDocGrounds (entity → document grounding). Grounding soundness (validator): every mention's span selects the entity's surface form out of the document text, so a claimed grounding always points at real evidence — the ingestion analog of the KnowledgeNugget derivation-grounding invariant.

id.description: Stable URN identifier. Pattern: urn:srcos:extracted-entity:<local-id>. Identity is stable and never reused.

specVersion.description: Contract version, pinned per the tranche-0001 discipline. Changing this const is a contract change.

surface.description: The entity's surface form exactly as it appears in the document text.

normalized.description: Canonical/normalized form used for cross-document linkage.

mentions.description: Where the entity occurs. Non-empty: an entity with no grounded mention is not extracted, it is asserted.

start.description: 0-based inclusive character offset into the document's hashed text.

end.description: Exclusive character offset. Invariant (validator): 0 <= start < end <= len(text).

confirmed.description: Whether the linkage to a canonical entity is confirmed vs residual/candidate.
